title: ssr_aap~
description: `ssr_aap~` is demonstrated as an audio-processing object in an SSR setup, using an oscillator and noise as source signals and feeding eight outputs to `dac~`. The example instantiates it as `ssr_aap~ 2 8channels.asd`, indicating a two-source, eight-channel configuration associated with the `8channels.asd` file, while `ssr_messages` provides related control messages.
